alex: which deploys are currently running?

jamal: this is the payment-retry hotfix — can we bump priority? customer-facing issue.

sre-oncall: oncall here — need a quick rollback and healthcheck plan first. If p50/p95 latency spikes >200ms for 5m we'll rollback.

alex: plan: smoke tests run, /health endpoint checks every 30s, rollback tag ready as rollback/v3.2.0 to pin old release.

maria: i'm watching logs and will paste healthcheck snippets to #support if anything odd. change window noted: 02:00-02:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy FINISHED (SUCCESS) in 87s. Post-deploy checks: smoke tests PASSED, /health=OK, p95 latency=180ms, error-rate stable.

jamal: great, thanks. I'll message ops with the customer update.

alex: pinning prod to v3.2.1-hotfix now and adding note to release notes about rollback procedure. Will open a short follow-up thread if we see regressions.
